_comment: The config store — the single source of truth for the cost 'knobs'. The control plane writes here; the data plane reads here. Changing behavior needs NO code deploy (mirrors file 06 §1).

routing._modes: balanced | cost | quality — mirrors Azure AI Foundry Model Router deploy-time modes

semantic_cache._note: similarity >= threshold => cache hit. Higher threshold = stricter = safer (fewer wrong-answer hits). Mirrors APIM llm-semantic-cache score-threshold.

budgets._actions: degrade (graceful, drop to cheaper model) | reject (hard 429-style)

evaluation._note: continuous eval samples this fraction of live traffic; if sampled quality < min_quality the decision binding reacts
